# FLX-3644: an emit with conditions is not drawn from declared statistics

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Conditioned rows are drawn from the weights of an emit's declared statistics, so the emit declares a fidelity block. An emit that takes its rows from the run's own events, and a reference expose, whose rows are published, have no cell whose weights a group could choose and are refused when they are given conditions.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3644
```
